api.description: Sends an authenticated request to the Rigbox API and prints the JSON response. `--body` takes inline JSON, a path to a JSON file, or `-` for standard input; a body that is not valid JSON fails before anything is sent. When the server answers with an error, the response body is printed as it was sent and the command exits non-zero; with `--output json`, the error event carries `status` and `body`. Inside a workspace, requests go through the workspace bridge, which serves only that workspace's routes.

ssh/add.description: Use this command from your local terminal. Registers a public key on your account and sets up `ssh <workspace>` on this machine: a `Host` entry per workspace in `~/.config/rigbox/ssh_config`, which `~/.ssh/config` includes. Without `--file` it uses `~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub`, then `~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub`, and creates an ed25519 key when you have neither. Without `--name` the key is named `laptop-` followed by your host name. A key that is already on your account is reported, not added again.
